title: Cirkus
desc: Two sets of identical twins are separated at birth and grow in two different cities. Years later, chaos ensues when one set of twins decides to visit the town where the other runs a circus.

title: Vaishnavi
desc: Born with the divine power, Vaishnavi receives treatment as a goddess by the villagers. After getting killed, she possesses the body of another girl who looks like her to exact revenge for her death.

title: Dacait
desc: After being mercilessly beaten and abandoned to die, a young man is rescued by a band of dacoits, who nurse him back to health in their hidden lair.

title: Aaj Ka Arjun
desc: A ruthless landlord exiles Bheema due to his rebellion against him. However, when his nephew is abducted, Bheema sets out to gain the support of the villagers and rescue the boy.

title: Real Tevar
desc: Harsha is the idealistic scion of a self-made multimillionaire, Ravikanth. After a chance meeting with Charuseela leads him to a remote village, Harsha wishes to develop it with her help.

title: Saugandh
desc: Sarang, an evil landlord, kills Ganga's family. Years later, Shiva, Ganga's son, marries Chand, Sarang's daughter, to seek revenge from Sarang by destroying his ego.
